tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rgyal po sku lnga 'khor bcas kyi gsol kha phrin las don bcu ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

dbang mchog pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo: chos skyong rgyal po sde lnga'i phrin las 'di la don bcu ste: dang po bzhengs su gsol ba: gnyis pa spyan drang ba: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba: lnga pa dam bsre ba: drug pa sman mchod 'bul ba: bdun pa mthun rdzas 'bul ba: brgyad pa bstod pa bya ba: dgu pa gsol ka bya ba: bcu pa las la bskul ba ste bcu las: dang po bzhengs su gsol ba ni: kye: dgung sngon mthon po'i yar steng nas: dmu bdud klu tsha sku bzhengs shig: byu ru smug po'i lding khang nas: bdud kyi rgyal po sku bzhengs shig: gru gsum mthing nag klong dkyil nas: spu gri 'bar ba sku bzhengs shig: shar phyogs dung gi sgo phyes la: zla 'od gzhon nu sku bzhengs shig: lho phyogs gser gyi sgo phyes la: 'gar ba dbang phyug sku bzhengs shig: gnod sbyin srid pa'i khong gseng nas: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir sku bzhengs shig: nub phyogs byu ru'i sgo phyes la: badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ti: dmu rje btsan po dbyings nas bzhengs: byang phyogs g.yu yi sgo phyes la: khyung gshog 'bar ba dbyings nas bzhengs: srog bdag chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: zhal gsum stod kyi mi bo che: dmu bdud brang dkar dbyings nas bzhengs: lcags kyi mi bo 'tshub nag can: dgra bla chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: khrag 'thung chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: nad kyi bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: nor gyi bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: stong dpon chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs kyi yum mchog dbyings nas bzhengs: shān+ti ro zan dbyings nas bzhengs: sku yi yum mchog dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud mo ro langs sku bzhengs shig: yon tan yum mchog sku bzhengs shig: gser gyi spu gri sku bzhengs shig: gsung gi yum mchog sku bzhengs shig: mdzes byed pad+ma sku bzhengs shig: phrin las yum mchog sku bzhengs shig: bdud bza' smin dkar sku bzhengs shig:

thugs kyi blon po srog bdag bya ra bzhengs: sku yi blon po bya khri mig gcig bzhengs: yon tan blon po bya rgod thang nag bzhengs: gsung gi blon po rdo rje grags ldan bzhengs: phrin las blon po pu tra nag po bzhengs: nang blon sha 'gros khyi 'gros 'dzin sdom dang: sa ka rdo rje 'bar ba dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor bcas gsang ba'i gnas 'dir sku bzhengs shig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: rā dza aṅku sha sa ma ya dzaḥdza: gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas: ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i chos skyong ni: gnod sbyin rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung ba'i skyes mchog rnams: thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i don ched du: chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar sku bzhengs la: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin chen po dang: yum gcig shān ti ro zan mthu mo che: blon po srog bdag bka' yi bya ra ba: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku yi rgyal po mon bu pu tra ste: gsang ba'i yum gcig bdud mo ro langs ma: bka' yi blon po bya khri mig gcig po: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: yon tan rgyal po gnod sbyin shing bya can: gsang ba'i yum gcig gser gyi spu gri ma: bka' yi blon po bya rgod thang nag can: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gsung gi rgyal po dgra bla skyes gcig po: gsang ba'i yum mchog mdzes byed pad+ma skyes: bka' yi blon po rdo rje grags ldan te: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: phrin las rgyal po zhal gsum mi bo che: gsang ba'i yum gcig bdud bza' smin dkar ma:

bka' yi blon po pu tra nag po ste: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a la la ho: e h+ye hi bha ga wān aṅku sha sa ma ya dzaḥdza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma traṃ bsgral pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: kha bub gan rkyal byi chings gdan du bsnol: rin chen sna lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas brtsegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyis mdzes par spras: ma chags lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnyis med brtan par bzhugs: dbus phyogs mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: thugs kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: shar phyogs dkar po dung gi gzhal yas su: sku yi rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: lho phyogs rin chen gser gyi gzhal yas su: yon tan rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: nub phyogs bye ru dmar po'i gzhal yas su: gsung gi rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: byang phyogs rin chen g.yu yi gzhal yas su: phrin las rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma ā be sha ya: badz+ra tri du ru sha hūm̐: badz+ra a ti ka ra ya: kha sgyur dkar po: sa ma ya dzaḥdza: ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten las las grub pa'i dregs pa can: rgyal po chen po sde lnga'i skur bstan pa: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: rgyal po sde lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: ā kar+sha ya ā be sha ya e h+ye hi ā ral+li ho: zhes pas 1$0000270gtso bo rnams la 'khor rnams kyis phyag btsal bar 1$0000300 bsam: lnga pa dam bsre ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes pas bdud rtsi byin brlabs la: spyi rgyugs su byed pa'i tshe: hūm̐: skyes mchog dgra bla chen po khyed: khyed dang bdag ni dam bsre na: dpal chen khrag 'thung gzu dang dpang: dus tshes 'di nas bzung nas ni: ji srid 'tsho yi bar dag tu: bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' bar:

rtag tu rgyal po mchod cing bsten: khyed kyang dam las ma 'da' bar: rtag tu bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: ci ste dam las khyod 'das na: rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo yis: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byed: rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi'i mchog: pañca a mṛta dang sbyar: dam tshig snying gi khrag chen po: bsre ba'i mchog ste srog gi snying: snying dang snying gi grogs por byas: rtag tu dam las ma 'da' zhig: badz+ra tri du rak+sha yak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā pañca a mṛta khā hi: zhes rang gi lce la'ang bzhag: rgyal po rnams la yang gtor bas: 1$0000270bdag dang rgyal po gnyis med du gyur te: ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bka' nyan zhing las byed par 1$0000300 bsam zhing dam tshig bsre'o: de nas rgyal po'i srog gi snying po rnams mdongs gsol du bya'o: drug pa sman mchod bya ba ni: ma traṃ gyi mchan khung nas dam rdzas kyi mchod pa blangs te 'bul ba ni: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: bstan pa bsrung phyir 'bar ba'i skur sprul pa: rgyud drug dgongs mdzad rig 'dzin sgrub mchog la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: hūm̐: dug lnga ma spangs sku lnga lhun gyis grub: 'gro drug bsgral phyir ye shes khro bo'i tshogs: gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: khams gsum dbang du bsdus pa'i sgrub mchog la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: gsung mchog chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: drag po'i gad rgyangs mi bzad ha har bzhad: dgyes pa'i glu len spyugs pa'i sgra sgrog pa: rkan brdabs grub pa thob pa'i gsung mchog la:

rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: thugs nyid don dam ngang las ma g.yos kyang: log lta bsgral phyir khams gsum kun la dgongs: thugs kyi sprul pas srid gsum kun la dgongs: rig 'dzin dbang lnga rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchog la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: sems nyid don dam ngang las ma g.yos kyang: log lta gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: 'jigs byed sku yi tshul du ston byed pa: gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po sde lnga la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: 'jig rten kun la dbang bsgyur mthu bo che: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir: rgyal po sde lnga'i sku la dgyes par 'khril: gsang ba'i yum chen bdud mo rnam lnga la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: bka' yi las mkhan mdzad pa'i mthu bo che: rgyal po'i phrin las myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir: bcol pa'i las rnams thogs med kun sgrub pa'i: dam tshig bsrung ba'i blon po rnam lnga la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la: cho 'phrul 'beb cing phung du gzhug pa'i phyir: stong gsum sprul pa dmag gis 'geng mdzad pa'i:

g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ru 'dren 'khor bcas la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rā tsa a ho brum rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: zhes sman mchod 'bul lo: bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: kye: dgra bla sku lnga yab yum 'khor bcas la: rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni: rin chen sna tshogs rgyal mtshan dag gis brgyan: mdzes shing yid 'ong zhal zas sna tshogs bshams: 'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod bsam mi khyab: dar gyi lda ldi 'phan gdugs phya ra ra: za 'og gur phub mdzes pa di ri ri: mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan sna tshogs rongs se rong: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil li li: sha chen rnams kyi dri ngad sbungs se sbung: gser skyems phud kyi rgyun ni brengs se breng: spos dang tshil chen dud pa thu lu lu: bshos gtsang zhal zas sprin ltar thibs se thib: spyan gzigs sna tshogs rdza ltar khra la la: 'di ltar bshams nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor du: gzugs kyi mchod pa sna tshogs bshams nas su: skyes bu chen po'i sku yi rgyan du 'bul: dgyes mdzad sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rgyal po'i sku mchog deng 'dir dngos su ston: sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: kye: dgra bla chen po 'bod pa'i sgra rnams ni: mi rkang mchog gi gling bu di ri ri: sgra snyan sil snyan mang po sil li li: pheg rdob cang te'u mang po khro lo lo: pi waṃ rgyud mang sgra byung brengs se breng: rnga dang dung dang cha lang la sogs pa: sna tshogs sgra yi mchod pa ji snyed rnams: rgyal po'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor de la 'bul: gsung gi sgra skad deng 'dir dngos su ston: ha ha'i gad mo sdang ba'i dgra la rgod: hi hi bzhad pas dbang dang ldan par mdzod: gdug pa'i nga ros thams cad zil gyis gnon: dgra bla chen po thugs kyi dbyings bstan pa:

chos dbyings skye med don la 'gyur ba med: brjod med bsam las 'das pa chos kyi sku: spros bral shes rab mi rtog bde ba che: chos kyi mchod pa rgyal po'i thugs la 'bul: gnag pa'i dgongs pa sdang ba'i dgra la mdzod: gdug pa'i bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra la mdzod: rgyal po'i yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ste: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa yang: de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin: 'jig rten 'di na che btsan pa: de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin: khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa yang: de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin: grags pa khyad 'phags thob pa yang: de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin: rgyal po'i phrin las thogs pa med: dam nyams ru tra'i snying rtsa 'dren: log lta mu stegs mgo bo 'gem: log lta tshe yi srog shing gcod: rnal 'byor dgra bo'i gzugs phung 'jig: 'di rnams rgyal po'i phrin las yin: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba pañca a ra ho: pū dza ho: rā dza ho: ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho: badz+ra yak+sha kha kha khā hi: dun+tiṃ dun+tiṃ khā hi: yak+sha nag po khā hi: sha 'gros ha ru khā hi: khyi 'gros hu ru khā hi: 'dzin po ru tra khā hi: sdom po 'chang rgyud khā hi: ru dra ru dra khā hi: go ro tsa na khā hi: tsit+ta ba su ta khā hi: rak+ta mtshul pa khā hi: sha rgyud snying rgyud khā hi: dbang po sna lnga khā hi: sha ma ru tri khā hi: ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho: pū dza badz+ra du ru ho: brgyad pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: sgrub mchog bdud 'dul ye nas thugs dam can: 'gro ba'i don mdzad thugs rje nyi ma 'dra: dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra bgegs kun sgrol ba: thugs rje snyom mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do: 'gyur med dbyings las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa: skye med chos kyi don rtogs sgrub mchog khyod: skye shi rtsad gcod legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa: thog med 'jigs byed khyod la bdag bstod do:

chos kyi dbyings las rtse gcig dgongs mdzad pa: g.yas pa'i bdud rtsis dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod: g.yon pas lcags kyus ru dra'i snying nas 'dren: khro rgyal bdud 'dul khyod la bdag bstod do: che ba'i nga rgyal drag pos khams gsum khyab: dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du gsol mdzad cing: nyon mongs log par lta ba rtsad nas gcod: bdud 'dul mthu chen khyed la bdag bstod do: sku gsung thugs ni chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam: phrin las mthar phyin khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul: drag tu bskul na dgra bgegs dbang du sdud: rgyal po sde lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do: ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: bstan pa srung mdzad drag po'i skur bstan pa: rgyal po sde lnga'i thugs dam dgyes bskul ma: yum chen rnam lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do: bka' yi las mkhan mdzad pa'i mthu bo che: rgyal po'i phrin las myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir: bcol pa'i las rnams thogs med kun sgrub pa'i: blon po rnam lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do: sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la: cho 'phrul dbab cing phung du gzhug pa'i phyir: stong gsum sprul pa dmag gis 'geng mdzad pa'i: 'khor gyi ru 'dren rnams la bdag bstod do: dgu pa gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: ho: dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin: chibs su ba glang sna ring la 'chib pa: sna gzung mon bu pu tras byas pa: sku mdog mthing nag la dar nag dang dom gyi slog pa gsol zhing: dbu la dar nag gi thibs zhu gsol ba: g.yas pas bdud kyi zhags pas dgra bo 'ching ba: g.yon pas spu gris dgra snying rtsad nas gcod pa: zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags sgrog pa: rol du glog dang me lce 'khrid pa: pho nyar thog dang ser ba gtong ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po mon bu pu tra:

chibs su seng ge dkar mo la 'chib pa: sku mdog nag po mun ltar gtibs pa: man tri nag po'i na bza' gsol ba: dbu la dar nag gi thibs zhu gsol ba: g.yas na gser gyi rdo rje gsor zhing brdeg pa: g.yon pas sher shing gseg shang bsnams pa: rol du dom nag smyon pa 'khrid pa: pho nyar stag gzig dom dred gtong ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: lho phyogs yon tan gyi rgyal po gnod sbyin shing bya can: chibs su bdud rta nag po la 'chib pa: sku mdog nag po sbrul dang stag gis brgyan pa: g.yas pa'i dgra s+t+was dgra bo'i mgo lus gshog pa: g.yon pas bdud zhags dgra la 'debs pa: dbu'i khyung mgos lha srin dbang du sdud pa: rol du srid pa'i g.yu 'brug khrid pa: pho nyar spra spre byi la gtong ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po dgra bla skyes gcig po: chibs su drel nag rkang dkar la 'chib pa: sku mdog dmar po 'od du 'bar ba: sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber dang dbu la smyug zhu gsol ba: g.yas sba'i 'gying mkhar bsnams nas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa: g.yon pas tsan dan gyi bing chen bsnams nas srid pa gsum 'joms pa: rol du spyang mo 'ur ba khrid pa: pho nyar lcags kyi bya khra gtong ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: byang phyogs phrin las kyi rgyal po pe har dgra bla chen po zhal gsum g.yas nag g.yon dmar dbus dkar ba: thod chen gyi steng na sag zhu gdugs thabs su gsol ba: phyag drug g.yas na lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri: g.yon pas spu gri gzhu dang ber ka bsnams pas: rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod cing: sku stod la dar dkar ral ga gsol ba:

sku smad la zhing lpags stag chas kyis brgyan pa: chibs su seng ge dkar mo la 'chib pa: sna gzung mon bu bha tras byas pa: rol du rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khrid pa: dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad: pho nyar bdud bya lcung ka gtong ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: thugs kyi dgra bla'i sprul pa dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad la: sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen gsol ba: shel gyi phreng ba'i mgul do byas pa: g.yas pas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar sgreng ba: g.yon pas zangs gri 'debs tshul mdzad pa la gsol lo: sku yi dgra bla'i sprul pa dge slong dgra bcom gzhon nu'i cha byad can: chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba: g.yas pas shel gyi gseg shang gsil ba: g.yon pas gser gyi spu gri bsnams pa: ka pa li rgyab tu 'khur zhing: spyi blugs bum pa mdun na 'chang ba la gsol lo: yon tan gyi dgra bla'i sprul pa sku mdog sngo skya men tri dmar po'i ga sha can: g.yas na sba gug mchu ring bsnams pa la gsol lo: gsung gi dgra bla'i sprul pa mthing nag ral pa gyen du brdzes pa: ag tshom ser nag me ltar 'bar ba: sku la stag gi slog pa gsol ba: phyag na zhing gi dbyug pa dang spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: phrin las kyi dgra bla'i sprul pa nag po zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi sku la gsol zhing: sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa: stag dang spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: thugs kyi rgyal po'i yum gcig shān+ti ro zan ma dmar mo khrag dang zhag gis brgyan pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa la gsol lo: sku yi rgyal po'i yum gcig bdud mo ro langs ma dkar mo dar dkar gyi go zu gsol ba: dam shing dang bhañja bsnams pa la gsol lo:

yon tan gyi rgyal po'i yum gcig gser gyi spu gri nag mo: zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: dbu la dar nag gi cod pan bcings pa: snyan g.yas sbrul dang dril bus brgyan pa: g.yon na seng ge ral pa can: phyag bzhi g.yas na ral gri dang mdung dmar 'dzin pa: g.yon pa shak+ti dang tri shu la'i mgul na ba dan 'phyar ba: mi mgo'i do shal glang chen gyi ko rlon: re lde ser po'i sham thabs dang sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa: zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa: bong bu gwa pa la 'chib pa la gsol lo: gsung gi rgyal po'i yum gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes: sku mdog dmar mo mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa: phyag gnyis dam shing dang bhan+dha bsnams pa la gsol lo: phrin las kyi rgyal po'i yum bdud bza' smin dkar ma: mthing nag bdud kyi slog pa gyon pa dam shing dang bhan+dha bsnams pa la gsol lo: bcol ba'i phrin las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: thugs kyi rgyal po'i blon po: srog bdag bka'i bya ra ba: sku la ber smug gsol ba: seng ge dkar mo la 'chib pa phyag na dar nag gi ru mtshon phyar ba la gsol lo: sku'i rgyal po'i blon po bshan pa bya khri mig gcig po: sbrul nag thod du bcings pa: chibs su sngon po sgab nag la 'chib pa: phyag na shel gyi rdo rje 'phen pa la gsol lo: yon tan gyi rgyal po'i blon po bya rgod thang nag dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad can: rdo rje dang tho ba thogs pa la gsol lo: gsung gi rgyal po'i blon po rdo rje grags ldan dar gyi chos gos gsol ba: rnga mong gwa pa la 'chib pa sher shing gi gseg shang bsnams pa la gsol lo: phrin las kyi rgyal po'i blon po pu tra nag po: sku la dar nag ral ga gsol ba: drel rta nag po la 'chib pa: gri gug phyag na bsnams pa la gsol lo: nang blon sha 'gros dang khyi 'gros: khol po 'dzin po dang sdom po 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo:

bcol ba'i las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig: ho: gnam gyi bla na byis pa lo brgyad pa: gnod sbyin rdo rje thog 'beb la gsol lo: rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul ba la gsol lo: lha'i dge bsnyen chen po ma hā kā la la gsol lo: mgon po nag po la gsol lo: bya rgod thang nag la gsol lo: srog bdag chen po la gsol lo: bha tra dkar po la gsol lo: pu tra nag po la gsol lo: srog bdag rngams pa la gsol lo: dmag dpon chen po la gsol lo: mthing nag mun ltar 'thibs pa'i nang shed na: gsal byed za 'og gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i nang shed na: rngam byed stag gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: nam mkha' sprin ltar gtibs pa'i nang shed na: mchong byed seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed na: srin mo rma bya'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba'i nang shed na: za byed spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: dkar mo nyi ma'i 'od kyi nang shed na: lding byed bya rgod kyi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: stong gsum sprul pa 'gyed pa'i nang shed na: spre'u dang byi la'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba la gsol lo: g.yas kyi ru 'dren dge slong stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo: g.yon gyi ru 'dren dmag dpon ban+dhe nag po a tsa ra'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo: sngon gyi shul mtshon bdud mo nag mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo: phyi'i rjes nyul ba blon po khol po 'dzin pa stag chas dang gzig chas su zhugs pa 'bum phrag stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo: sku yi skyo sangs 'bag seng gar mkhan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo: seng ltar 'phyong ba la gsol lo: stag ltar rngams pa la gsol lo: khyung ltar lding ba la gsol lo:

khra ltar 'dzul ba la gsol lo: spyang ltar rgyug pa la gsol lo: spu gri mched lnga la gsol lo: stong dpon mched bdun la gsol lo: rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spyan gzigs longs spyod rgyan dang ldan pa 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: phrin las mngon du mdzod cig: bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyungs shig:

ces pa'i rjes la phrin las bcol ba'i tshigs rgyas par spro'o// bcu pa las la bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: steng phyogs rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas: 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'gro drug gnas 'dir bzhengs: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul ston cing: thugs rje'i ngang nyid snang srid mtha' la gzigs: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la: bdag gi bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub par mdzod: rgyal po khyed ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: kun rdzob don du zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: zhe sdang sbrul gyi chun pos sku la brgyan: ru dpon tshul du stag gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: 'jigs pa'i tshul du ber smug dgu brtsegs gsol: rngams pa'i tshul du zhal gdangs ha ha bzhad: khros pa'i tshul gyis sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: za byed rtags su spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i don ched du: zhi ba'i ngang las mi bzad khro tshul can: ag tshom ser nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba ni: nyi zla'i thod phreng can yang dbang du sdud: zhabs gnyis bskyang bskum tshul du bzhugs pa ni: klu yi rgyal khams ma lus zil gyis gnon: phyag mtshan zhing gi dbyug tho 'phyar ba ni: log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs dbang du sdud: bstan pa bsrung phyir seng ge dkar mo 'chib: sku la spyan gzigs stag gi pags pa gsol: dgra la rbad na ba glang sna ring 'chib: gtum po chen po dom gyi chas ldan pa: phyag mtshan spu gris dgra snying tshal par 'gems: log par lta ba'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: skyes pa mi bzad stag gi chas su zhugs: g.yon gyi lcags kyus 'dren zhing spu gris gtub: thugs dam tshul bzhin drag tu bskul pa'i tshe: gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod: bstan pa gzhung bzhin srung ba'i skyes mchog khyod:

rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe: cho 'phrul ston pa dgra bcom gzhon nu'i tshul: dbu la snyug zhu dar nag 'thibs dang ldan: phyag g.yas tsan dan g.yon pas gseg shang bsnams: gsang ba gser gyi rdo rje gsor zhing rdeg: bdag gis rbad pa'i las rnams 'grub par byed: zhal gsum phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod: drel rta bcibs nas khams gsum dbang du sdud: phyag mtshan par bus dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: sba gug mchu ring dgra bo'i srog rtsa 'dren: shel phreng dkar pos yi dam rtag tu 'dzin: dgra s+t+wa kha ches dgra bo'i klad pa gshog: zhags pa nag pos dgra bo'i bla srog 'gugs: rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i las rnams myur du sgrub par mdzod: sa ma yā: dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo bh+yo: rgyal po chen po'i gsol ka 'di: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nor lha nag po'i rgyud nas btus: da lta spel ba'i gnas med pas: rnam par snang mdzad dbu la sbas: chos 'khor srung ba'i mtshon char bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
